clips.title: The story
paras: A Dusty Unsent Letter is a forgotten parchment recovered from an old footlocker in Westfall. It offers vital proof that the elusive Stalvan Mistmantle lived in Moonbrook before his disappearance.

While searching for the past of the mysterious Stalvan Mistmantle, investigators discover this unsent letter tucked away inside an old footlocker in Moonbrook. Darkshire's town registry still listed his last address as the Moonbrook Schoolhouse, and Clerk Daltry wanted word on whether he had truly lived there. This unmailed correspondence provides the missing link, confirming that Stalvan resided in the Westfall township for a time. Yet its presence also raises ominous questions, as retrieving it disturbs a vengeful Forlorn Spirit that guards the remnants of Stalvan's past with bitter malice.
